source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of characteristics of threats (PDF 180).

blocks.text: Har security threat ki apne features (khaas baatein) aur nuqsan pohanchane ka apna tareeqa hota hai.

Spam ko pehchanna aksar aasan hota hai kyunke yeh bari tadaad mein aata hai aur us mein unwanted ads hote hain. Is ke ulat spyware peeche chupke se (background mein) kaam karta hai aur aasani se nazar nahi aata. Spam emails mein ajeeb offers ya suspicious (shak wale) links hote hain jo unhein alag dikhate hain, jab ke spyware baghair kisi saaf nishani ke khamoshi se aap ki activities ko monitor karta (chupke se dekhta) hai.

Har threat ka tareeqa aur maqsad alag hai. Spam cheezein bechna ya dhoke se kuch khareedwana chahta hai. Spyware chupke se aap ki personal maloomat jama karne ke liye bana hai. Cookies aap ki browsing ki aadaton ka data jama karti hain. Phishing dhoke se aap ki personal details nikalwane ki koshish karti hai. Pharming aap ki maloomat churane ke liye aap ko jaali websites par bhej deti hai. Yeh farq samajhna har khatre se bachne ke liye zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaunsa khatra pehchanna sab se mushkil hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Spyware, kyunke yeh background mein khamoshi se kaam karta hai aur koi saaf nishani nahi deta, jab ke spam bari tadaad, ads aur ajeeb offers ki wajah se aasani se pehchana jata hai.

items: Spam: saaf nazar aata hai, bari tadaad mein ads; spyware: chhupa hua, khamoshi se monitor karta hai.
Maqsad: spam bechna ya dhoka, spyware maloomat jama karna, cookies browsing ka data, phishing details nikalwana, pharming jaali site par bhejna.
